body: ## Summary Switching chats was slow because its wake request and conversation read had to wait behind workspace reads still running for the chat just left. The browser allows 6 connections per host, and slow git-backed reads held all of them. The worst was the "@" file list: `/workspace/files` took 1–4 s and sent 1.2 MB, because it sniffs every file and reads git state, all to get a list of names. - **Cancel on leave.** Workspace manifest and history reads take the query's abort signal, so leaving a chat frees the connections it held. Opening Files prefetches the manifest, so a cancelled read isn't retried. - **Names-only file list.** New `GET /api/v1/sessions/{sessionId}/workspace/paths` returns paths from the cached path inventory, minus files missing on disk, with no binary sniffing or git state. "@", transcript file links and file search use it, and search fetches details only for the rows it shows. - Git projects now reach 20,000 files; the file browser and scratch projects keep the 5,000 cap. - Under the cap, changed files come first across every repo. - Search keeps deleted rows, as before, and matches every file, not just the first 20,000. - Daemons without the route return `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`. The app then falls back to the full list and remembers that host. - **"@" says it's loading.** While the list is on its way, "@" shows "Loading files…", the same note "/" shows for skills. - **Start the conversation read earlier.** The session route starts it in its loader on navigation (not on hover preload). - **No session-list re-read on open.** Every row field a wake changes (activity, launch id, provision state) already arrives through change events. A stopped chat still reloads its history once, because clearing the sleep marker emits no event. ## Before / after (real data) **Measured on the daemon side**, on this repo's real worktree (8,009 files): | | Before | After | |---|---|---| | "@" file list | 1.15 s cold, capped at 5,000 files | ~78 ms cold / ~25 ms warm, all 8,009 files | | File search per keystroke | ~950 ms | 7 ms warm / ~270 ms cold | Client-side ranking per keystroke at the new cap: 20k paths 11 ms, 50k 30 ms, 100k 51 ms. That cost is why the cap stops at 20,000. **Measured in the app** (production renderer build, real data, n=9, median / p75) with an earlier prototype of this PR. That prototype cancelled reads on leave and deferred the "@" list to the first "@": | | Before | Prototype | |---|---|---| | Switch chats: longest wait for a connection | 1,917 / 3,284 ms | 192 ms | | Switch chats: wake request sent at | 2,035 / 3,411 ms | 434 / 466 ms | | Switch chats: data transferred | 1.3 MB | 0.43 MB | | Open from idle → first message | 431 / 514 ms | 397 / 447 ms (unchanged) | **Inferred, not re-measured:** in this final version the list loads once the chat shows again (transcript links need it), but from the names-only route instead of the 1–4 s full list. Switch waits should stay close to the prototype's. For an 8k-file repo, the transferred data rises by the ~420 KB list. ## "@" while the file list loads (real data) Typing `@sess` in a real local chat. The live daemon is a release build without the new route, so this also exercises the fallback to the full file list. The transcript is hidden for privacy. | | While the list loads | After it loads | |---|---|---| | Before | | | | After | | | ## Tests - Go: `workspace_file_paths_test.go` covers: - parity with the full list - plain `rm` and staged `git rm` (hidden from "@", still found by search) - listing past the 5,000 cap - changed files kept first when capped, across repos - workspace child-repo prefixes - scratch projects A controller test covers 200, empty, and 404. - Frontend: - the paths route, and the old-daemon fallback that's remembered per host - the "Loading files…" note and Escape - a stopped chat reloads its history once after opening, a ready one not at all, and neither re-reads the session list - Targeted Go and Vitest suites pass locally, as does a typecheck of `src/`. ## Risks / follow-ups - The loader prefetch covers local chats only, not chats on remote hosts. - Overlaps with draft #7273 on the session-list re-read after registration. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
title: perf(chat): open and switch chats without waiting on workspace reads
